Name: Abigail is a Cat Now
Author: MattytheMouse
Description:
This mod makes a few adjustments to Abigail's character sprite. Her bow no longer randomly changes which side of her head it is on, her legs are no longer bowed, and on top of that, her character portraits have been completely redone.

Also, she's a cat now. Meow.

Yes, I do plan on making Stardew Valley more like Animal Crossing with similar edits to other characters. For now however, I am uploading this to provide a taste of what's to come and open myself up to suggestions.

Downloads.Description: Turns Abigail into a kitty cat.
